functions.name: ih264d_api_function
functions.description: Central API entry point for the Ittiam H.264 decoder. Callers pass a decoder handle and command-specific input/output structures to create/destroy the codec instance, decode bitstreams, flush/reset, query status/buffer info, and issue control sub-commands (e.g., set cores, get VUI/SEI, get buffer dimensions). The concrete input/output structs used are those defined in this header (e.g., ih264d_create_ip_t/op_t, ih264d_video_decode_ip_t/op_t, ih264d_ctl_get_vui_params_ip_t/op_t, etc.), each carrying an e_cmd (and for control, e_sub_cmd) and size fields. The function returns an IV_API_CALL_STATUS_T; detailed error/status is reported via the output struct’s u4_error_code with helper macros (IS_IVD_*). Note: Exact handle lifetime and thread-safety guarantees are not specified here; usage follows the Ittiam IV/IVD API pattern.
requirements: ps_handle: must be a valid pointer to an iv_obj_t representing the decoder instance for most commands; for create operations, many Ittiam IV/IVD APIs accept a NULL handle (inferred from library pattern) — exact allowance is not explicitly stated here.

pv_api_ip: must be non-NULL and point to the correct input structure corresponding to the requested command; the structure’s u4_size must be set to sizeof(struct) and, where applicable, e_cmd (and e_sub_cmd for control) must be populated.

pv_api_op: must be non-NULL and point to the corresponding output structure; the structure’s u4_size must be set to sizeof(struct) before the call so the callee can validate buffer size; after return, check u4_error_code for detailed status.

Command/structure pairing must be correct (e.g., use ih264d_create_ip_t/op_t for create, ih264d_video_decode_ip_t/op_t for decode, ih264d_ctl_get_vui_params_ip_t/op_t for VUI query, etc.). Mismatched structures are invalid.

Callers should use the provided error macros (e.g., IS_IVD_FATAL_ERROR, IS_IVD_UNSUPPORTEDPARAM_ERROR, IS_IVD_INSUFFICIENTDATA_ERROR) to interpret the u4_error_code bits returned in the output structure (inferred from macros present).
All size and command enum fields included in the various ip/op structs (e.g., u4_size, e_cmd, e_sub_cmd) must be initialized by the caller prior to invocation.

Memory pointed to by any pointer fields inside ip/op structs (e.g., bitstream buffers, QP/type maps, display buffers) must be valid for the duration of the call and sized as specified by their accompanying size fields; specific size/layout requirements are defined by the corresponding struct comments (e.g., 8x8 map sizes) and must be respected.

This API may return success with non-fatal conditions indicated via error code bits (e.g., concealment applied); callers should not assume hard failure unless fatal bits are set (inferred from IVD error bit macros).
